authority_model.auto_approval_disposition: auto_approve_threshold is refused when it would drive a non-dry-run actuator (hard runtime guard in the orchestrator); the supported live path (ControlledScalingExecutor) requires a separate external ExecutionAuthorization.

legacy_imports.note: Legacy operational namespaces are monorepo-only compatibility surfaces (object identity preserved); not part of the distributed wheel and not a stable API.

reference_store_limitations: InMemoryIdempotencyStore and InMemoryAuditSink are process-local reference implementations; they are NOT durable and NOT sufficient for multi-process production deployment.
known_limitations: Contains infrastructure-mutation capability; installation alone does not authorize execution.
Dry-run is default; LIVE requires external authorization, target allowlists, credentials, readiness, audit sink, and idempotency storage.
In-memory idempotency/audit stores are not production-durable; exactly-once across distributed processes is NOT guaranteed.
Not live-cluster validated; not production certified. No cost/reliability/safety claim established by packaging tests.
Kubernetes/ArgoCD/webhook/metrics/OTLP integrations may require optional extras or injected clients.
provenance_policy: Build revision generated at build/verification time from GITHUB_SHA or `git rev-parse HEAD` into artifacts/build_provenance.json (CI-generated). No self-referential commit SHA is stored here.
